Knowledge of the history of Flevoland, shipbuilding, and/or the seventeenth century is a plus, but not required. We'll provide the basic information and help you make the stories your own. 
 What do we expect from you? - Schedule: One to two weekend days every four weeks and/or one weekday per week.
